home.title: Property for Sale and Rent in the Balkans
home.description: Homes for sale and rent in Albania, Kosovo, North Macedonia, Montenegro, Serbia, Bosnia, Croatia, Bulgaria, Romania and Greece, with maps, prices and buying guides.

search.title: Property for Sale in the Balkans – Map Search
search.description: Search apartments, houses, villas and land for sale on an interactive map. Filter by country, city, price, size and rooms, and contact the seller or agent directly.

rentals.title: Property for Rent in the Balkans
rentals.description: Find apartments and houses for rent across the Balkans on an interactive map. Filter by city, monthly rent, size and rooms, and send a viewing request to the owner.

exploreCities.title: City Pages – Prices and Neighbourhoods Across the Balkans
exploreCities.description: Compare cities across the Balkans: asking-price history, districts, economic indicators and the listings currently available in each city.

mortgageCalculator.title: Mortgage Calculator
mortgageCalculator.description: Estimate the monthly mortgage repayment and total interest for a property in the Balkans, and compare the cost of renting with buying over the years.

valuation.title: Property Price Estimate
valuation.description: Get a free automated indication of a property's value in the Balkans from comparable listings and its location. An estimate to start from, not a valuation.

agents.title: Real Estate Agents in the Balkans
agents.description: Find real estate agents in Albania, Kosovo, Montenegro, Serbia, North Macedonia, Croatia and the rest of the region, with their listings, areas and contacts.

agencies.title: Real Estate Agencies in the Balkans
agencies.description: Browse real estate agencies across ten Balkan countries, with their agents, current listings, office locations and how to contact them.

blog.title: Blog – Buying and Renting Property in the Balkans
blog.description: Articles on buying, renting and owning property in the Balkans: market news, prices, taxes, the legal steps and tips for buyers from abroad.

howItWorks.title: How BalkanEstateAI Works
howItWorks.description: How searching, listing and contacting sellers works on BalkanEstateAI for buyers, renters, private sellers, agents and agencies, and what each plan includes.

contact.title: Contact BalkanEstateAI
contact.description: Contact the BalkanEstateAI team for help with your account or a listing, to report a listing, or to ask about advertising and plans for agents and agencies.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How BalkanEstateAI collects, uses and protects personal data, which cookies, analytics and advertising it uses, how long data is kept and how to use your rights.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.description: The terms that apply to using BalkanEstateAI: accounts, publishing property listings, paid plans for agents and agencies, acceptable use and liability.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.description: Which cookies BalkanEstateAI uses – necessary, preference, analytics and advertising cookies – what each one is for, and how to change your choice at any time.
